entries.en: Hmhm... Looks like your friend's[n]in danger.

entries.en: Whoa, hold on there. What will happen[n]to your friend if I make my move?

entries.en: Don't you want to save them? Then[n]give me some of your stamina.

entries.en: Hmm... This isn't enough.
entries.uk: Гм... Цього замало.

entries.en: Give me [f 2 5 3 9999 3] this time.[n]I don't think you're in a position[n]to refuse me...

entries.en: ...That's not enough to satisfy me.[n]Perhaps I should demand more...?

entries.en: This time, you better pay up. I want[n][var 0] yen. It's a cheap price[n]to pay for your friend, right?

entries.en: ...I want to live the good life, you know.
entries.uk: ...Я, знаєш, хочу жити красиво.

entries.en: Why don't you give me some of your[n]health? I'm sure that's no issue, since[n]it's to save your friend.

entries.en: Hmm, doesn't this feel a little rushed?

entries.en: Why don't you give me some of your[n]stamina? I'm sure that's no issue since[n]it's to save your friend.

entries.en: Heheh, I guess that's enough. I'll release[n]your friend.

entries.en: ...Okay, that's enough. Here, I'll give you[n]back your friend.

entries.en: Does that mean you're going to abandon[n]your friend? Such cold-heartedness...

entries.en: Guess I've got no reason to hold back[n]then. You're going to regret what[n]happened here today.

entries.en: You're quite cold. Don't you care about[n]your teammate?
entries.uk: А ти холодний. Хіба тобі байдуже[n]до товариша по команді?

entries.en: ...Ugh, this isn't worth my time.[n]I'm leaving!

entries.en: That's it, I'm done! I'm leaving!

entries.en: ...Well then, let's get back to business.

entries.en: Huh!? What nerve!
